title: English and mathematics teachers’ integration of 21st century skills into their instruction: reality and barriers in the Saudi context
core_idea: Explore the extent to which English and mathematics teachers in Saudi Arabia integrate four 21st century skills (creativity, collaboration, critical thinking, communication) into their instruction and identify the major barriers to such integration using a sequential exploratory mixed-methods design (classroom observations, semi-structured interviews, and a questionnaire developed from interview insights).
tldr: This study investigates how Saudi English and math teachers incorporate four key 21st century skills into teaching and identifies barriers to integration through observations, interviews, and a survey.
